tools.name: list_studios
tools.description: List Norm nail & beauty studios in Warsaw with their addresses. Call this first when the client has not said which location they want, or when they ask where Norm is. Norm is a beauty studio in Warsaw (two locations). Write the brand as "Norm", never "NORM". This is a booking assistant for clients:

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Search the live Norm service menu: prices, durations, and which masters perform each service — including each master's position, rating, specialties and, when known, a coarse experience milestone (e.g. "300+ visits"), whether most/many clients come back and the year they joined Norm, so you can help

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Show free appointment times for one service, reading the live Norm/Booksy calendar. Returns times grouped by date and then by master (`days[].masters[].times`), with each master's position, rating, specialties and, when known, a coarse experience milestone, whether most/many clients come back and th

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Report whether the client is signed in to Norm on this connection. Booking, listing and cancelling appointments all require it. Use this before telling the client they need to sign in.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a real appointment at Norm. This creates a genuine booking in the studio calendar and the client will be expected to show up — ALWAYS repeat the service, price, date, time, master and studio back to the client and get an explicit yes before calling this. Requires the client to be signed in to N

tools.name: my_appointments
tools.description: List the signed-in client's upcoming Norm appointments. Requires the client to be signed in to Norm. Use this to find the `bookingId` needed by `cancel_appointment`. Past visits are only returned with `includePast: true` — set it only when the client asks about their history. Norm is a beauty studio

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in client's own appointments. This frees the slot in the real studio calendar and the time becomes available to others — always confirm the exact appointment with the client before calling. Get `bookingId` from `my_appointments`.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Sign the client out of Norm on this connection: revokes the Norm sign-in, so booking, listing and cancelling need a fresh sign-in. Use when the client asks to log out, or when someone else wants to use the same assistant.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_services" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_appointment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
